topic.title: Searching in a Review Task
topic.shortdesc: Use the Search page in a review task to find text across all review task files and filter the results.

body.p: Click Search in the left stripe to open the Search in Task page for the current review task. This page lets you search for content in all files attached to the task. If a file is open in the visual editor, the page opens in a side pane to the left of the editor.

p.note: To search or filter review items (comments, highlights, and so on), use the separate Reviews side view.

body.p: Enter the text you want to find in the search field. The search looks for matches in the text of all task files. For advanced search options, see Advanced Search Syntax. A short reference is also available in the user interface through the help icon next to the search field.
Click a result to open the file in the review task visual editor. The Search in Task page then remains open as a side pane to the left of the editor.
